'''Snopell''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who served [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Warrant Officer/Legends|Warrant Officer]] Snopell was assigned to an Imperial [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], along with [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Alin]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Clough]], Lieutenant [[Farin]], Captain [[Bailie]], [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Sheray]] and [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Taison]].<ref name="SWG:NPT" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] captured a passenger freighter on suspicion of harboring criminals.<ref name="SWG:Oc">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=other|Opening crawl}}</ref> Several [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] were apprehended and taken to the Imperial Space station. After the spacers were released, Snopell processed them through the space station until they left the station.<ref name="SWG:NPT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Snopell was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:NPT" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Warrant Officer Snopell was added to the game when the developers revamped the "New Player Tutorial" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 17 Notes for 26 May 2005|Publish 17]]," on [[May 26]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> Throughout the tutorial, Snopell and other Imperial officers directed new players through a space station in order to help them get accustomed to the game mechanics.<ref name="SWG:NPT" /> However, Snopell was removed alongside with this tutorial when the developers introduced the "[[:w:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]" on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:2005" /> With this revamp, a completely [[:w:c:swg:New Player Tutorial|new tutorial]] was added to the game in the form of [[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]]. Another Imperial officer with a similar name, [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Snopel]], was present in the Tansarii Point tutorial.<ref name="SWG:C">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Commando|Commando|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref>
